name: Peruque Creek
places: Mike Clemens Center for Adaptive Learning
about: Peruque Creek drains about 25 square miles, all of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 640 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 430 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Peruque Creek. St. Charles County communities here include O'Fallon, St. Paul, Josephville, Lake St. Louis and Wentzville. Downstream, its water passes through the Cuivre Island-Mississippi River, Bolter Island-Mississippi River and Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
